title: APIs requiring live network access (reference)
description:
Source item 2's statistics sub-part, item 3 (countries API), and item 4 (UCI dataset page) all need either a live third-party API or web scraping - checked directly rather than assumed:

- Item 2 (min/max/mean/median/stdev of cats' weight and lifespan): the same task as `stats_summary` in 30days-d11-l2-04 - see that exercise instead of duplicating it here.
- Item 3.2 (10 most spoken languages) and 3.3 (total number of languages): the same task, with real data, as 30days-d19-l1-02 and 30days-d10-l3-03.
- Item 3.1 (10 largest countries): restcountries.eu (the source's URL) is dead; the country data already bundled in this repo (countries_data.json) has no land-area field, so this can't be answered faithfully - interpreting 'largest' as 'most populated' would just repeat 30days-d19-l1-03.
- Item 4 (UCI ML dataset repository): a page to scrape with BeautifulSoup4 (not installed in this sandbox), with no single fixed correct answer - explore it directly in a browser instead.
